title: How to Check Video Cable Connections
overview: Help a reviewer support the Check Video Cable Connections step without changing the workflow automatically.
checklist: Ensure the video cable (HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-C, VGA, DVI) is securely connected at both the computer's output port and the monitor's input port. If possible, try a different video cable or a different port on both the computer and monitor.
common_indicators: Record the observed result and return to the originating workflow.

quiz.question: What should you do after completing this support step?
answers: Record the result and return to the workflow
quiz.correct_answer: Record the result and return to the workflow
